newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: FORECAST - Portugal sees '96 budget gap at 4.1 pct.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Portugal sees '96 budget gap at 4.1 pct.

text.p: Portugal expects a budget deficit in 1996 of 4.1 percent of gross domestic product (GDP) and has revised downwards the figure for 1995 to 4.9 percent from 5.2 previously, the Bank of Portugal said in a monthly report.
"With respect to 1995, the most recent estimate is 759.6 billion escudos (4.9 percent of GDP)," the Bank said, quoting finance ministry data.
"The deficit predicted for 1996 is 683.3 billion (4.1 percent)", it said. The official budget target is 4.2 percent but the government had already said it expected it to be lower.
